dialogue_segments.text: Mother...

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Desperate, Shouting)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I have done nothing!

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Screaming, Hysterical)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I saved her! I healed her!

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Shouting in Anguish)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I saved the Duchess!

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (V.O.) (Sorrowful, Wounded)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: They took my mother's ledger...

dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: They took her locket. But they will not take Alexander from me.

action_segments.text: Juliana trembles uncontrollably, her fingers digging into the collar of her rustic dress as terror washes over her.
